zh.title: Cirium下修未來20年新機交付預測至43,000架
zh.summary: Cirium下修未來20年交付預測，2026至2045年估43,000架
body: Cirium下修未來20年新飛機交付預測。其年度《Fleet Forecast》預測，兩個十年期間將交付43,000架飛機。2026至2045年間全球新客機、貨機及渦輪螺旋槳飛機的交付預測，較Cirium在2025年的預測低約8%；當時預測為46,500架。
Cirium的預測指出，整個2020年代需求可能持續高於供應。全球客運機隊預計到2045年將略超過50,000架；中國、印度及更廣泛的亞太地區合計約佔模型預測客運機隊的48%。單走道飛機則佔預測客運機隊的76%。

en.title: Cirium cuts 20-year aircraft delivery forecast to 43,000
en.summary: Cirium cuts its outlook; 43,000 aircraft deliveries are forecast for 2026–2045.
body: Cirium has cut its forecast for new aircraft deliveries over the next 20 years. Its annual Fleet Forecast projects 43,000 aircraft deliveries over a two-decade period. The forecast for new passenger and freighter jets and turboprops worldwide between 2026 and 2045 is around 8% below Cirium’s 2025 forecast of 46,500 aircraft.

Cirium’s forecast says demand is likely to continue outstripping supply throughout the 2020s. It projects that the global passenger fleet will reach just over 50,000 aircraft by 2045. China, India and the wider Asia-Pacific region together account for approximately 48% of the modelled passenger fleet, while single-aisle aircraft account for 76% of the forecast passenger fleet.

zh.title: 烏克蘭擴大攔截高速噴射無人機的防空系統
zh.summary: 烏克蘭擴充攔截系統，涵蓋無人機、自動砲塔與小型飛彈。
body: 烏克蘭正擴大可用於攔截高速無人機的系統範圍。Aerospace Global News報導，總統Volodymyr Zelenskyy列出的相關系統包括攔截無人機、自動砲塔及小型飛彈，這些系統正在研發或部署中。
國防部長Yevhenii Khmara表示，部署攔截無人機以對付噴射動力無人機已取得成功；他也表示，數百座大口徑砲塔正在部署以應對這類無人機。報導引述他稱，一支部隊在一次作戰行動中使用5架Bars攔截器摧毀5個空中目標，並稱該次行動成功率為100%。

en.title: Ukraine expands air-defence options against fast jet-powered drones
en.summary: Ukraine is developing and deploying interceptor drones, automated turrets and small missiles against fast drones.
body: Ukraine is expanding the range of systems available to intercept fast drones, Aerospace Global News reported. President Volodymyr Zelenskyy outlined three systems being developed or deployed: interceptor drones, automated gun turrets and small missiles.

Defence Minister Yevhenii Khmara reported successful results from deploying interceptor drones against jet-powered drones and said hundreds of heavy-calibre turrets were also being deployed. The report quoted him as saying one unit destroyed five aerial assets with five Bars interceptors during a combat operation, describing that operation as a 100% success rate.

zh.title: Corendon航班傳出7500代碼後由戰機護送至紐倫堡（NUE）
zh.summary: Corendon航班傳出7500代碼後由戰機護送至紐倫堡（NUE）
body: Corendon定期航班XR456由科孚島（CFU）飛往紐倫堡（NUE）。航班途中，飛機曾發出7500劫機應答碼；報導指出，Eurofighter Typhoons奉命攔截並護送該航班前往機場。
Corendon表示，飛機約於09:00 UTC因無線電通訊系統故障，短暫發出緊急代碼。該公司稱，飛行期間並無緊急狀況，乘客、機組員及飛機均未處於危險中。報導另稱，飛機於10:00 UTC稍後安全降落，乘客與機組員無人受傷。

en.title: Corendon flight escorted to Nuremberg (NUE) after transmitting code 7500
en.summary: Corendon flight XR456 was escorted to Nuremberg (NUE) after transmitting code 7500.
body: Corendon scheduled flight XR456 was operating from Corfu (CFU) to Nuremberg (NUE). While en route, the aircraft transmitted squawk code 7500, associated in the report with a hijacking alert. Eurofighter Typhoons were scrambled to intercept the flight and escort it to the airport.

Corendon said the aircraft briefly transmitted the emergency code at around 09:00 UTC because of a malfunction in its radio communication system. The airline said there was no emergency during the flight and that passengers, crew and aircraft were never in danger. The report said the aircraft landed safely shortly after 10:00 UTC, with no harm to passengers or crew.
